column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Gomorrah's Collectivist Debate
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Though the $$救世主$$s have honored us with their visit,
I am sorry you had to witness something so embarrassing.
This is no time for that!
What are those so-called Grievance Inspectors?
That young lady they just took away...
Release her now!!
This city always puts the $$平等$$ of its citizens first,
yet there are still people troubled by such personal feelings.
For everyone to lead a happy life free of discrimination,
personal feelings must be restrained as much as possible!!
Surely you see? If everyone puts only their own interests first,
a society of $$平等$$ could never exist!!
That is why we assign residents their work quotas,
and direct everything up to the city's development plans.
We supervise and carry them all out.
Yet some selfish residents cannot agree even with something so simple,
so we restrain them and reeducate them into exemplary comrades.
That is the very purpose of the Grievance Inspectors!
I see...
“I see” is not the right response, old man!
Still, he is not entirely wrong.
But if we cannot save even one person, how can we bring happiness to everyone...?
That is the sort of sophistry often used on children!!
When considering everyone's happiness,
we may sometimes need to take measures that appear heartless to outsiders.
Wait!
But that means the people of this city have no $$自由$$!
Unlimited $$自由$$ can sometimes create unimaginable chaos!
Only on the foundation of everyone's happiness can individual $$自由$$ exist.
Is that not so?
If you understand, I would now like you to hear our request.
As you have already heard from $$マルコ$$,
we want you to protect our city from the $$異端審問会$$ and Sodom's clutches!!
